text:
anya: Quick design check — prototyped a "high-density" dark heatmap for the Console (more cells, smaller gutters). Thoughts on contrast/legibility? Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz-high-density. Screenshot attached.
sam: Nice! Main issue I see: when cells get <6px the visual weight disappears. The current accent (electric teal) creates a harsh halo on hover in dark bg. Maybe a softer accent or inner glow instead of outer?
kai: From infra perf POV we want to keep canvas rendering (no DOM per cell). If we add inner strokes/patterns we should bake them into the canvas paint path. Patterns hurt export but can be raster-only for small sizes.
joy: Accessibility checklist: small interactive targets need visible focus and text >12px for tooltips. For the color ramp, perceptual uniformity (e.g., cividis/viridis) performs better than pure hue shifts for small bars. Also avoid relying on glow alone for emphasis — glows can be invisible under certain gamma settings.
anya: Copy nit: legend currently says "hot -> cold" which is ambiguous. Suggest explicit phrasing: "Frequency: rare → frequent" and include numeric ranges. Also we should avoid the word 'hot' in product copy.
sam: Proposal for palette variants: A) soft-indigo ramp (deep indigo -> teal -> cyan), B) warm-cool ramp (muted magenta -> slate -> cyan). I'll upload both swatches. Which reads better on #07090B background?
kai: Quick rendering note: use premultiplied alpha and avoid CSS backdrop-blur on the heavier overlay — it causes jank on older GPUs. If we need separation, bump tooltip opacity to 0.9 and add a subtle 2px shadow.
design-bot: Auto-contrast-check: legend label #9fb0bf on bg #07090b => contrast 3.9:1. Small text will fail WCAG AA. Suggest #c7d8e3 or semibold weight.
joy: Also: consider non-color encoding for minimal values — e.g., hollow cells, micro-hatching, or a thin inner dash. For exports, include a short caption: "Heatmap legend: 0-3% (hatched), 4-15% (indigo), 16-50% (teal), 51-100% (cyan)."
anya: Good suggestions. UX question: for keyboard navigation should arrow keys move cell focus or jump by row/column? Thoughts from a11y folks?
joy: Arrow by cell is ideal but needs a clear focus ring — 3px solid #2563eb or a 2px outer + 1px inner stroke so it reads on dark backgrounds. Also ensure screen reader announces "Row X, Column Y, token frequency Z%".
sam: Small CSS prototype for focus and minimal glow:
```
:root{--focus:#2563eb;--tooltip-bg:rgba(6,8,10,0.92);}
.heatmap-cell:focus{outline:3px solid var(--focus); box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(2,6,23,0.6)}
.heatmap-cell.hollow{background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#ffffff08 0 2px,#0000 2px 6px)}
```
kai: Will accept canvas baked variants for hollow/hatched pixels. Keep the sprite small to avoid GPU churn.
anya: I prefer the indigo ramp (A) but with a less aggressive hover glow. Sam, can you post both swatches plus small screenshots of the legend at 32px and 16px?
sam: Will do. Quick poll: indigo (:+1:) or warm-cool (:-1:)?
design-bot: Poll update: indigo 4, warm-cool 2.
joy: One last micro-copy tweak: change tooltip label from "Count" to "Token frequency" and add unit "%" — non-technical PMs keep asking what count means.
anya: Thanks all. Actions: Sam -> upload swatches + 16/32px legend screenshots; Kai -> canvas export hatching prototype; Joy -> a11y focus spec + sample SR strings. Target: finalize colors by EOD and include in next sprint.
